summary: APPROVE. Both r1 CRITICALs are genuinely closed against the actual tree, not cosmetically. CRITICAL-1: the OpAtomicOr scope is now keyed on the SAME `uses_coopmat` predicate that already drives the memory-model branch (verified emit.rs:148-165 — a single `if uses_coopmat` gates BOTH `Capability::VulkanMemoryModel` and `MemoryModel::Vulkan`, so no drift between the memory-model and scope decisions is possible), choosing `Scope::QueueFamily` under Vulkan and `Scope::Device` under GLSL450. This is SPIR-V-airtight: `QueueFamily` (5) is enabled by the `VulkanMemoryModel` capability that coopmat kernels already declare and does NOT require the optional `VulkanMemoryModelDeviceScope`; a Relaxed(None)-semantics atomicOr at QueueFamily scope is exactly what real Vulkan-memory-model buffer-atomic shaders emit — net capability set is baseline on both legs, and AT-2867 now spirv-vals BOTH legs asserting caps gain nothing. CRITICAL-2: the §5 gate now requires the write to UNCONDITIONALLY DOMINATE exit via a conservative syntactic top-level check, and the node name is corrected to the real `HirStmt::BufferWrite { buffer_binding, index, ... }` (verified expr.rs:291-296 — the field is literally `buffer_binding`, and the r1-loose `IndexAssign` appears exactly once, only to disclaim it). The discipline it mirrors (`stmt_reassigns_binding_unconditionally`, body.rs:836, non-descend into If/ForRange/While) is verified real and semantically identical, and the spec explicitly names loop-nested writes as rejected. Guarded-write → PostconditionNotLowerable with no unguarded exit read (AT-2877). Both integration gaps closed: the flag binding is APPENDED to `binding_plan.buffers` so all four consumers agree — verified they all read that one list (pool sizing context.rs:1636, DSL pipeline.rs:78 via buffer_position, generic bind loop context.rs:834-871 indexes binding_plan.buffers by position); and the readback routes through the real NonCoherent invalidate path (verified `AXC_FORCE_NONCOHERENT_STAGING` / `force_noncoherent_staging` exist, context.rs:120/167, AT-2879 exercises fail-closed). All mandates landed: §4 pins `%bad = OpLogicalNot(OpFOrd*)` NaN-fail-loud with AT-2878; §2 states observational-only / NO-early-return / OpSelectionMerge / single-trailing-return explicitly; §7 uses `skip_serializing_if` (no `"debug_checks":null`); §10 keys at_1115 on the `"llvmpipe"` substring (never `lavapipe`), leaves `within_ulp_f32` untouched (verified pub(crate), already takes a `ulp: u32` arg — only check_saxpy's hardcoded `ulp_tolerance: u32 = 4` local is replaced; M3.16's rewrite_verify.rs:465 reuse is unweakened), threads a per-call arg, and forbids the >64 silent clamp (fail/re-measure instead). AT range 2861..2879 is collision-free (M3.16 owns 2841..2860 and stops there; no milestone uses 287x; ceiling 2880 honored). No coding-blocking issue remains. Two NON-BLOCKING nits below for the Coder.
warnings: NON-BLOCKING (AT-2867 coopmat cap assertion precision): the AT text asserts the coopmat leg's caps `== {Shader, VulkanMemoryModel}`. A real coopmat kernel's baseline also carries CooperativeMatrixKHR (+ Float16/Int8/8-16bit-storage as needed), so the literal two-element set is illustrative, not exact. The operative claim stated alongside — `== baseline coopmat set` / `the atomic adds nothing` — is correct. RECOMMEND the Coder implement AT-2867's coopmat leg as a DIFFERENTIAL assertion: capability set of the kernel compiled `--debug ON` == capability set of the SAME kernel compiled `--debug OFF` (byte/set-equal), rather than a hard-coded list. This is self-maintaining and directly proves 'the atomic adds nothing' without enumerating the coopmat baseline. Same differential form strengthens the GLSL450 leg too.

NON-BLOCKING (runtime binding_plan provenance for the sidecar-load path): all four descriptor consumers correctly read `binding_plan.buffers`, so APPENDING the flag slot is sound. One provenance detail for the Coder to keep consistent: when a dispatch reconstructs `ParamBindingPlan` from a loaded v4 metadata sidecar (as opposed to an in-process compile→dispatch that carries the plan directly), the appended flag `BufferBindingSlot{buffer_position=num_user_buffers}` must be materialized from `DebugChecksMeta.flag_binding`, and the runtime must also allocate/zero/pass the (N+1)th buffer/size so the bind loop's index→position mapping (context.rs:834) lines up. The spec's §7 'append + alloc/zero/bind flag buffer' covers this; just ensure BOTH the codegen-time plan AND any metadata-reconstructed plan get the appended slot (no path that rebuilds the plan from user-buffer count alone).
spirv_concerns: CONFIRMED-RESOLVED: OpAtomicOr scope under the Vulkan memory model. `Scope::QueueFamily` requires only the `VulkanMemoryModel` capability (already declared by coopmat kernels) — NOT `VulkanMemoryModelDeviceScope`. A Relaxed(None)-semantics atomicOr at QueueFamily scope needs no storage-class/availability bits and is valid; this is the standard Vulkan-memory-model buffer-atomic form. Net capability delta on both legs is zero. Airtight.

CONFIRMED-RESOLVED: GLSL450 leg keeps `Scope::Device` (valid with Capability::Shader alone for a 32-bit StorageBuffer u32 Relaxed atomicOr). No QueueFamily leaks onto the GLSL450 leg and no Device leaks onto the Vulkan leg (verified §2/§4/§11/§14 all consistent).

CONFIRMED-RESOLVED: NaN fail-loud. `%bad = OpLogicalNot(OpFOrd*…)` is pinned in the §4 table for EVERY float comparison (FOrd returns false for NaN ⇒ LogicalNot ⇒ %bad=true ⇒ flagged). §4 explicitly forbids FUnord* and forbids inverting the comparison operator. AT-2878 exercises a NaN operand setting the bit. No comparison is left bare or FUnord.

CONFIRMED: host readback is fence-ordered (queue→host domain) PLUS the NonCoherent invalidate leg; Relaxed atomicOr aggregation is order-independent (OR is commutative/idempotent), so the final flag word read after the fence is the exact union of contributions. No NonPrivate/availability decoration required on the flag SSBO for host-read correctness.
CONFIRMED: postcondition if-block and precondition if-block each emit OpSelectionMerge (structured CF); observational-only (no early return) sidesteps the BarrierInDivergentContext class.
vendor_concerns: QueueFamily-vs-Device split is vendor-neutral. AT-2867's coopmat (Vulkan-memory-model) leg must be spirv-val'd + (ideally) executed on real NVIDIA, since Lavapipe does not exercise the coopmat memory-model branch identically — the spec already scopes GPU ATs to real NVIDIA + Lavapipe.
Fail-closed coherency is exercised on Lavapipe via AXC_FORCE_NONCOHERENT_STAGING=1 (AT-2879), covering the non-HOST_COHERENT class (some mobile/AMD) without hardware.
